attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 over their shared transit network (10.200.0.0/30 on eth1), routing node3's private lan-a (192.168.10.0/24) and node4's private lan-b (192.168.20.0/24) across it. node3 and node4 now reach each other by private address, and packet captures confirm cross-site traffic is opaque encrypted WireGuard UDP on the transit link while the same traffic is plaintext ICMP on the private LAN legs. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time (leaves first, then routers) per the mandatory restart protocol, and connectivity/tunnel state was confirmed to persist and auto-recover after each restart.
